pois.name: 부산타워
pois.description: 다이아몬드 타워(구 부산 타워)는 용두산 공원에 120미터 높이로 우뚝 서 있으며, 방문객들에게 부산과 아름다운 해안선의 숨막히는 전경을 제공합니다. 이 상징적인 랜드마크는 멋진 경관을 보여줄 뿐만 아니라 다양한 문화 행사를 개최하여 도시의 문화적 풍경의 활기찬 일부분이 됩니다. 다보탑에서 영감을 받은 독특한 디자인은 한국의 풍부한 유산을 반영하며, 관광객들이 이 지역의 자연미와 문화적 의미를 탐험하도록 초대합니다.
pois.intro: Busan Tower is a 120-metre-high tower at Yongdusan Park, located in Jung District, Busan, South Korea. It was built in 1973.

pois.name: 재한국 국제연합 기념공원
pois.nameEnglish: United Nations Memorial Cemetery in Korea
pois.intro: The United Nations Memorial Cemetery in Korea, located at Tanggok in the Nam District, of Busan, South Korea, is a burial ground for United Nations Command casualties of the Korean War. It contains 2,300 graves and is the only United Nations cemetery in the world.

pois.name: 광안대교
pois.intro: The Gwangan Bridge or Diamond Bridge is a suspension bridge located in Busan, South Korea. It connects Haeundae District to Suyeong District.

pois.name: 부산항대교
pois.intro: Busan Harbor Bridge is a bridge in Busan, South Korea. The bridge connects the districts of Yeongdo District and Nam District.

pois.name: 광안리해수욕장
pois.intro: The Gwangalli Beach or Gwangan Beach is a beach in Gwangan 2-dong, Suyeong District, Busan, South Korea. It is west of Haeundae Beach.

pois.name: 감천문화마을
pois.intro: Gamcheon Culture Village is a town within Gamcheon-dong, Saha District, Busan, South Korea. The area is known for its layered streets, twisted labyrinth-like alleys, and brightly painted houses, which have been restored and enhanced in recent years to attract tourism.

pois.name: 부산근대역사관
pois.intro: The Busan Modern History Museum is a museum in Busan, South Korea. The building was originally constructed during the Japanese occupation of Korea for the Oriental Development Company an organisation used to support Japanese colonization of Korea.

pois.name: 용두산공원
pois.intro: Yongdusan Park is a park located in Jung District, Busan, South Korea. The 120-meter-high Busan Tower is located here.

pois.name: 임시수도기념관
pois.intro: The Provisional Capital Memorial Hall is a museum in Bumin-dong, Seo District, Busan, South Korea. The building was used by the President of South Korea, Syngman Rhee, when Busan was the provisional capital of South Korea during the Korean War.

pois.name: 부산공동어시장
pois.intro: The Busan Cooperative Fish Market is the largest fish market in South Korea. It adjoins the South Harbor in the city of Busan, and more than 30% of the country's fish production passes through the market.

pois.name: 부산박물관
pois.intro: Busan Museum is a museum located in Busan, South Korea, open since 1978.

pois.name: 일제강제동원역사관
pois.nameEnglish: National Memorial Museum of Forced Mobilization under Japanese Occupation
pois.wikipedia: en:National Memorial Museum of Forced Mobilization under Japanese Occupation
pois.intro: The National Memorial Museum of Forced Mobilization under Japanese Occupation is a national history museum in Busan, South Korea. It first opened on December 10, 2015.

pois.name: 국립해양박물관
pois.intro: The National Maritime Museum is in Greenwich, United Kingdom.

pois.name: 유엔평화기념관
pois.intro: The United Nations Peace Memorial is a memorial in Busan, Gyeongnam, Korea. As an affiliated organisation of the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs, the United Nations Peace Memorial was established on November 11th, 2014, in order to pay respects to the soldiers of the UN Forces who sacrificed their lives to protect and defend the freedom and peace in Korea.

pois.name: 위안부 평화비
pois.intro: 慰安婦の碑（いあんふのひ）とは、旧日本軍慰安婦に関する石碑。日本、大韓民国、アメリカ合衆国に設置されている。

pois.name: 부산시립미술관
pois.intro: The Busan Museum of Art is a museum in Busan, South Korea.

pois.name: 봉래산
pois.intro: Bongnaesan är ett berg i Sydkorea. Det ligger i provinsen Busan, i den sydöstra delen av landet, 300 km sydost om huvudstaden Seoul.

pois.name: 민주공원
pois.intro: Democracy Park is a historic park located in Central Park, Jung District, Busan, South Korea. It was established on October 16, 1999 in honor of the protestors who participated in the various democratic movements that led to the democratization of South Korea, including those of the April Revolution, Busan–Masan Uprising, and June Democracy Movement.

pois.name: 송상현광장
pois.intro: Song Sang-hyeon Square is a public open space on Jungang-daero Avenue in Jeonpo-dong, Busanjin District, Busan, South Korea. It is South Korea's largest square.

pois.name: 부산시민공원
pois.intro: Busan Citizens Park is a public park in Busanjin District, Busan, South Korea. It was formerly an Imperial Japanese Army base and United States Army camp.
